about.description: xStocks is the consumer brand of Backed Finance for tokenized US equities and ETFs, designed for non-US users with permissionless transferability. Each xStock token (e.g., AAPLx, NVDAx, TSLAx, SPYx) is 1:1 backed by real shares held in custody by Backed Assets (JE) Limited (Jersey SPV), with a Swiss FinSA-compliant base prospectus. Unlike whitelisted tokenized stocks, xStocks are free-float ERC-20/SPL tokens that can move freely across DeFi venues. Launched on Solana then expanded to Ethereum, BNB, Gnosis, Base, Arbitrum, and Ink. Combined exchange and on-chain trading volume crossed $10B+ within 6 months of debut. Acquired by Kraken in 2025 to accelerate global tokenized-equity expansion.
about.registryInfo: xStocks is the consumer-facing brand of Backed Finance AG (Zug, Switzerland). Tokens are issued via Backed Assets (JE) Limited, a Jersey-domiciled SPV that holds the underlying shares. Each xStock is a free-float (non-whitelisted) ERC-20/SPL token tracking 1:1 the underlying share. The structure is tracker-certificate-based under Swiss FinSA prospectus and DLT-Act regulation, allowing transferability without on-chain whitelist enforcement. Acquired by Kraken (announced 2025) — Kraken is the primary distribution partner.
about.founders: Adam Levi (Co-Founder), Yehonatan Goldman (Co-Founder), Roberto Klein (Co-Founder)
about.regulatoryStatus: xStocks are tracker certificates securitized as ledger based securities under Article 973d of the Swiss Code of Obligations. They are issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, a Jersey company registered with the Jersey Financial Services Commission holding COBO and CGPO consents, under a base prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA in May 2025 and renewed May 2026 with EEA passporting. Products are not offered to US persons and confer economic exposure only with no voting rights.
about.keyMilestones: 2026-04: xStocks live on BNB Chain with 50 plus tokenized stocks | 2025-12: Kraken announced agreement to acquire Backed Finance AG after 10 billion dollars combined volume | 2025-06: xStocks launched on Kraken, Bybit, and Solana DeFi | 2025-05: Liechtenstein FMA approved the base prospectus | 2021-05: Backed Finance AG incorporated in Zug
about.entityStructureNotes: Backed Finance AG in Zug is the parent tokenization company and the subject of the December 2025 Kraken acquisition agreement. xStocks are issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, a Jersey special purpose issuer, with each product collateralized 1 to 1 by the underlying security held with custodians.

fees.revenueNotes: Currently no issuance, redemption, or management fees per the official FAQ, though the prospectus reserves the right to charge per product. KYC verified primary clients mint and redeem directly at NAV subject to minimums. Dividend handling economics are not disclosed.
